capabilities: Open the current note in Cursor from the command palette, context menu, or sidebar
Open entire project folders in Cursor
Configure the Cursor executable path, window behavior, and default project folder
extras: The README's demo section is a placeholder saying to include a GIF or video. Requires Cursor to be added to the system PATH (or a custom path set in settings); supports Windows and Apple systems.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to hand a note or folder off to the Cursor editor, so switching between notes and Cursor-assisted coding takes manual steps.

relations.evidence: Seamlessly bridge your notes with Cursor, the AI-powered code editor.

summary: Integration that opens Obsidian notes and folders directly in the Cursor code editor via commands, context menus, and a sidebar icon.
